Poultices, prepared by crushing the leaves and applying them to the skin, are effective for relieving pain and promoting healing in wounds. Tinctures, created by soaking the plant in alcohol, provide a concentrated form for internal use, while mucillages, derived from the plant’s gel-like substance, are used to coat and protect the mucous membranes.
